_purpose: Verification intent document — authored by verification engineer
_note: This is the only file the engineer writes per project. No signal names. No class names. No UVM knowledge required.

project.description: AHB-to-APB bridge — converts AHB master transactions to APB slave transactions

stimulus.description: Small fixed transaction count — enough to exercise each verification goal once

verification_goals.goal: Every transaction address driven on the AHB interface must appear unchanged on the APB interface
Write data sent on AHB must reach APB without corruption
Read data returned from APB must reach the AHB master unchanged
A write transaction on AHB must produce a write on APB. A read must produce a read. Direction cannot flip.
An error response from the APB slave must be visible as an error response on the AHB side
No transaction must be lost or duplicated — every AHB transaction must produce exactly one APB transaction
